title: dryopteris banajaoensis
intro: Dryopteris banajaoensis, commonly known as a species of fern, is a type of plant belonging to the Dryopteris genus. It has been traditionally used in Thai medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its purported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris banajaoensis are believed to be anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial, making it a potential candidate for treating various ailments. However, the specific bioactive constituents responsible for its effects are not well-documented, but they are thought to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites.
